# M10: Units 12–15 and checkpoint D (sharps, flats, naturals)

Goal: units 12–15 and `cp-d` playable; Practise includes sign cards; Progress shows them.
Spec: SPEC §8.6 (name-accidental, find-key-pitch), §8.9 (card lessons, review), §8.10, §8.11;
CURRICULUM §7, §8 (P mixes), §10 units 12–15, §11 (their concept cards), §12.

## Steps
1. **Tokens:** add `--unit-12` … `--unit-25` (all 14 now, so later milestones don't touch
   `tokens.css`); contrast test covers them.
2. **Domain:** question kinds `name-accidental` and `find-key-pitch`, answers `pitch-name` and
   `pitch-key`, options rule (§8.6), `checkAnswer`, `correctAnswerOf`, `cardOf`, prompts and
   feedback text (CURRICULUM §12), `hintFor` → null for sign cards. Tests for each rule,
   including every candidate-dropping case of the options rule. `content.test.ts` checks the
   quoted texts of CURRICULUM §5 only (it stops at the next `## ` heading); add the same check
   for §12 (and keep it passing in M11–M13 as their texts arrive).
3. **Curriculum data:** units 12–15 and `cp-d` exactly as CURRICULUM §10; concept cards of §11
   used by these units (`c-sharp`, `c-sharp-staff`, `c-flat`, `c-two-names`, `c-bass-signs`,
   `c-natural`, `c-signs-grand`); Meet-card tips (§7). Add the new ids to `ids.lock.json`.
4. **Builder:** card lessons for units 12–15 (first slot of a new card = `name-accidental`),
   `showNaturals`, `buildReview` with sign cards, `buildCheckpoint` with `mix`. Property tests
   extended (STANDARDS §3 + §8.9).
5. **UI:** `NameAccidental` view (2 × 2 buttons with symbols), `FindKeyPitch` (black keys
   answer), MeetCard for sign cards (black key highlighted, plays the black key), feedback extra
   lines, sound of the sounding pitch.
6. **Path:** units 12–15 and the cp-d node (after unit 15). **Progress:** the "Sharps and flats"
   chart and units 12–15 in the unit list.
7. **E2E** (`e2e/part2-signs.spec.ts`): every new lesson and cp-d opens and completes via
   `data-answer` (phone, `test.slow()`); a wrong black key; a right black key's "also called"
   line; review with seeded sign cards; cp-d pass from fresh progress → units 12–15 marked done, no errors;
   loading the v1 fixture shows u12-l1 as current when u11-l4 is done.
8. Screenshots + visual QA (light/dark, 390/320) for both new views, a sign Meet card, the Path
   around cp-d and the new chart. `HANDOFF.md`, `NOTES.md`. `npm run verify` green; "debug again".
9. Replace the runtime throw for `render: 'rhythm'` only if M10 needs it; `buildCheckpoint` must use
   `CheckpointDef.mix`/`material` for cp-d (today it ignores them and would silently build a plain
   name-the-note test); add a test that a checkpoint with a mix really uses it.

## Review step (Opus)
Review prompt from `docs/build/README.md` with M10 (`/code-review high`).

## Acceptance
- A learner who finished unit 11 continues into unit 12 with nothing lost; units 12–15 and cp-d
  are playable start to finish. `npm run verify` green.
